basis: The first sentence obscures the direct relationship between plugins and core functionality with “is based on a modular design where” and “are implemented to provide.” A direct statement preserves modularity and leaves the distinct plugin support rules intact.
replacement:
containerd is modular, with plugins providing its core functionality.
Plugins implemented in tree are supported by the containerd community unless explicitly specified as non-stable.
Out of tree plugins are not supported by the containerd maintainers.
